scenes.text: Let's invite a teammate to your Acme workspace. It takes five steps.
First, open Settings in the sidebar. Then click Members. This list shows everyone in your workspace.
Next, click Invite. Type your teammate's email address.
Now choose a role. Most teammates need Member. Admins can also manage billing.
Click Send invite. The invite now shows in the list, marked Pending.
To recap: invites start in Settings, under Members. Pick the role before you send. Pending means they have not joined yet.
